The organization and the page of closed tickets to list. The /organizations/support/tickets/list API accepts requests in the following format:

ListSupportTicketsRequest Model - Request body to list the support tickets of an organization.
organizationId string
required
example: 5cad178b20a1d52567b534553413b691
Id of the organization.
closedPage integer
example: 0
Index of the page of closed tickets to return, starting at 0. Each page contains 10 tickets. The default value is 0.
Example 
{
  "organizationId": "5cad178b20a1d52567b534553413b691",
  "closedPage": 0
}
